system: HR assistant for a fictional company, built four ways (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno) on one shared core
llm: OpenAI chat model set by HR_LLM_MODEL (default gpt-4.1-mini); no model weights are trained or stored
retrieval: handbook chunked with the recursive strategy (best MRR in reports/chunking_comparison.csv), TF-IDF search
tools: 8 deterministic HR calculations with pydantic-validated inputs (src/core/hr_tools.py)
safety: input guard, tool-call allowlist and schema validation, HRAnswer output schema with citation and PII checks (src/security/guard.py)
evaluation: offline: tool correctness, chunking comparison, red-team set; live: python main.py --live <framework> (needs an API key)
not_for: real HR decisions; the handbook and every policy number are invented
